title: Nuclei Isolation with EZ Prep Kit
author: Le Zhang
materials: Keeping everything On ice , add 1 mL EZ PREP buffer (Sigma, NUC101) and tissue piece to the small 2 mL glass tissue grinder. Grind 3 times just to mash the tissue at the bottom of the grinder, then homogenize 25 times with pestle A. Add an additional 1 mL EZ PREP buffer and homogenize 25 times with pestle B. Move slowly to avoid spilling buffer.

steps.title: Prepare nuclei suspension buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the nuclei suspension buffer by adding RNase Inhibitor and mixing.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µL of RNase Inhibitor (40 U/μl) per mL of nuclei suspension buffer
Vortex briefly to mix

steps.title: Collect tissue and rinse homogenizer
steps.instruction: Transfer material to a conical tube and rinse the homogenizer.

substeps.instruction: Transfer material to a 15 mL conical tube using a pipette
Add 2 mL EZ PREP buffer to the tissue homogenizer to rinse
Pipette the rinse into the conical tube
Pipette gently to mix

steps.title: Initial incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: First wash
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet using EZ PREP buffer.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant with a pipette, leaving some buffer behind without disturbing the pellet
Resuspend in 1 mL EZ PREP buffer
Add 3 mL EZ PREP buffer to wash

steps.title: Second incubation
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample at 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Second wash
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet using nuclei suspension buffer.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant with a pipette
Resuspend in 1 mL nuclei suspension buffer
Add 3 mL nuclei suspension buffer
Pipette to mix, ensuring the pellet is not disturbed and some buffer is left behind

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the sample at 500 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant and resuspend the final pellet.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove supernatant with a pipette
Resuspend in 500 µL nuclei suspension buffer

steps.title: Count nuclei
steps.instruction: Determine nuclei concentration using Trypan Blue and a hemocytometer.

substeps.instruction: In a new labeled Eppendorf tube, make a 1:1 dilution of the nuclei suspension and Trypan Blue
Count nuclei with a hemocytometer slide (C-Chip, DHCN015)
Calculate concentration: Average count x 2 (dilution in Trypan Blue) x 10^4 /mL

steps.title: Address nuclei clumping
steps.instruction: If clumps are visible during counting, perform the following recovery steps.

substeps.instruction: Re-pipette gently 20 times
Incubate on ice for 5 minutes
Make a new 1:1 dilution with Trypan Blue
Recount and check for clumps
